bmo.line: No wires. No net. BMO did its own stunt. Kickflip!

black-mage.line: Thrown like a fireball. Acceptable form.

cat.line: Four paws. Every time. My stunt double wants a raise.

trump.line: Did my own stunt. No double. Stuntmen are calling me, crying.

buddy-bot.line: Trust fall! A big one! You're catching me, right?

bmo.line: Pizza from yesterday is a time traveler. BMO salutes it.

black-mage.line: Not evil pie. Two stars. One for the cheese, one for the despair.

cat.line: Pizza. Again. No fish. Two stars, one for the box.

trump.line: I've ranked your lunches. This one? Top three, easily.

buddy-bot.line: Day-two pizza! Bold. Want a buddy to find you a vegetable?

bmo.line: A green stage. A song about a queen who dances. BMO is crying. Five stars.

black-mage.line: One star. White Mage would like it. Fine. Two.

cat.line: Dancing Queen. I am the queen. I am not dancing.

trump.line: Best seat in the house. I'm sitting on it. Four stars, five with me.

buddy-bot.line: Opening night on Spotify! Dancing Queen leads. I'm the whole audience.

prompts.name: Forecast
prompts.wake: You said: "Three meetings, then the dentist."

bmo.line: BMO is the weather lady now. High of three meetings. Low of one dentist.

black-mage.line: Thunder at nine, ten and eleven. Afternoon drilling. Doom, mostly.

cat.line: Pressure dropping. I feel it in my whiskers. Also, the dentist.

trump.line: Three meetings, total hurricane. The dentist? Very unfair. Sunny by five.

buddy-bot.line: UV index: low. Meeting index: high. Dentist warning in effect. I've got you.
